{"result":"{\"id\": \"page_qa_runbook\", \"space_id\": \"space_ENG\", \"parent_id\": \"page_eng_home\", \"title\": \"QA Regression Runbook\", \"body\": \"

Manual QA regression pass run against every release candidate before we submit a build for review. Owned by QA (Vincent Parker); anyone cutting a build can run it, but a green matrix here is a gate on the Release Checklist & Store Submission. Scope covers Domino Delights (internal codename GoD, \\\"Game of Dominoes\\\"), Zombie Match 3D (listed as \\\"Puzzles vs Zombies\\\" until the July 2025 rename). Budget a few hours per title - the first five chapters alone run over an hour; if something fails, file the bug and block the release, don't hand-wave it.

Test the UPDATE path, not just a fresh install. The June 2025 progression losses were on Domino Delights, and nobody ever reproduced them - the leading hypothesis was the update path, which is why we test it. Every candidate must be installed over the last two shipped versions and checked for save/progression loss before we ship. If we only test fresh installs we will miss this entire class of bug again.

Recurring bug classes to always check

These four have all bitten us in production. Treat them as non-negotiable checks on every pass, on real devices, not just the emulator.

  • Font / asset download stall on splash. In May 2025 Domino Delights froze at roughly 22% on the splash screen while pulling remote fonts and assets (ENG-2346, build 0.2.197). Watch the loading bar all the way to gameplay; test on a throttled/slow connection and with the app cache cleared.
  • Lives & scheduler regeneration. Confirm lives tick back up on the timer, refill correctly after device clock changes, and that offline time is credited without over-granting.
  • Quest population & reset. New quests populate on a fresh session, complete correctly, and roll over at the daily/weekly reset without duplicating or leaving empty slots.
  • Save / progression integrity. Level, coins and unlocks survive an update, a force-quit and a re-launch. This is the one the June 2025 wipe belongs to.

Regression matrix

Run each row on at least one iOS and one Android device. Both update rows are mandatory - N-1 and N-2 are the last two shipped store versions.

AreaFresh installUpdate from N-1Update from N-2Notes
Splash / asset loadPassPassPassWatch for the ~22% stall (May 2025 Domino Delights)
Save / progressionPassPassPassJune 2025 wipe never reproduced in-house; update path is the leading hypothesis
Lives & schedulerPassPassPassTest with device clock changes
Quests populate / resetPassPassPassCheck daily + weekly rollover
Purchase / restorePassPassPassSandbox account. NOTE: entitlements do not restore on reinstall and receipts are not validated server-side - see the per-title IAP row below. Check the purchase grants client-side, not that it restores.

If a check fails

  • File the bug with device, OS version, source build and repro steps, and link it here.
  • A failure in any UPDATE column blocks the release - fresh-install-only regressions do not pass the gate.
  • Player-facing symptoms (lost progress, stuck splash, missing lives) should be mirrored to the Customer Support Playbook so support has a known-issue note before it hits the store.

Once the matrix is green, tick the QA sign-off on the Release Checklist & Store Submission before submitting to the stores.

Per-title regression matrix

Each release candidate is walked through the full matrix below on at least one iOS and one Android device. A cell fails the gate if the observed behaviour deviates from the expected column; file the bug, mark the matrix red, and block the submission.

\\n\\n\\n\\n\\n\\n\\n\\n
AreaCheckExpectedDominoZM3D
First-time UXFresh install \\u2192 tutorial \\u2192 first winNo stall; tutorial completes; first level winnableYesYes
Font / localisationCold start on a fresh device (no cached font)UI renders; no blank/boxed glyphs at ~22% loadYesYes
ProgressionPlay 3 levels, force-quit, relaunchLevel and currency persist; no reset to level 1YesYes
EconomyEarn + spend coins, buy a boosterBalances reconcile; booster consumed once.YesYes
Live-opsEnter the active event; complete a questEvent loads; quest ticks; rewards grantedYesYes
IAPSandbox purchase + restoreItem is granted client-side and purchases cannot be restored on reinstall. Receipts are effectively NOT validated: Domino Delights' Node backend exposes a POST /validate-receipt route, but it is dead scaffolding - validateReceipt() is never defined or imported, it logs undefined variables (bodyRequest, packId), and on success it grants nothing and returns undefined. Zombie Match 3D has no such route at all. Treat the route's existence as a trap: do not assume verification because an endpoint is there.YesYes
AdsWatch a rewarded ad to completionReward granted once; no double-grant on retryYesn/a
\\n

Known-issue regression cases

These are the incidents that have bitten us in production; every one now has a permanent regression case so it cannot silently return. Reproduce the trigger, confirm the fix holds.

\\n

Font-download stall. On a fresh device the dynamic font pack could fail to download, freezing the UI at ~22% of the splash-screen load (this is a position on the loading bar, not a share of players). Regression: install on a wiped device with a throttled connection; confirm a fallback font renders and load continues.

\\n

Progression reset. Returning players were once dropped back to level 1 with their player id unchanged in Metabase; the cause has not been established. Regression: migrate a save across a reinstall; reinstall with a LINKED Apple/Google account and confirm the server profile rehydrates. Quest-chest progression is known not to survive this (ENG-2114); unlinked guest accounts cannot be recovered at all.

\\n

Quest not resetting / not populating. A bad deploy left the daily quest board empty. Regression: roll the clock across a UTC day boundary; confirm quests repopulate and completion state resets.

\\n

Device lab

The minimum matrix is one recent + one old device per platform. We keep a small physical lab plus a cloud device farm for the long tail.

\\n\\n\\n
PlatformRecentOld / min-specTablet
iOScurrent-gen iPhone, latest OSiPhone SE-class, oldest supported OSiPad (one gen)
Androidcurrent-gen Samsung / Pixellow-RAM device, oldest supported OSone Android tablet
\\n

Sign-off

QA posts the completed matrix in #god-bugs (Domino Delights) or #zombie-bugs (ZM3D) and links it from the release ticket. A build without a green matrix should not get submitted. In practice Friday is the usual release day and builds have shipped without a completed pass - QA has asked for a Friday freeze but it has not been adopted.

The June 2025 progression losses were on Domino Delights, and nobody ever reproduced them - the leading hypothesis was the update path, which is why we test it. Every candidate must be installed over the last two shipped versions and checked for save/progression loss before we ship. If we only test fresh installs we will miss this entire class of bug again.

Recurring bug classes to always check

These four have all bitten us in production. Treat them as non-negotiable checks on every pass, on real devices, not just the emulator.

  • Font / asset download stall on splash. In May 2025 Domino Delights froze at roughly 22% on the splash screen while pulling remote fonts and assets (ENG-2346, build 0.2.197). Watch the loading bar all the way to gameplay; test on a throttled/slow connection and with the app cache cleared.
  • Lives & scheduler regeneration. Confirm lives tick back up on the timer, refill correctly after device clock changes, and that offline time is credited without over-granting.
  • Quest population & reset. New quests populate on a fresh session, complete correctly, and roll over at the daily/weekly reset without duplicating or leaving empty slots.
  • Save / progression integrity. Level, coins and unlocks survive an update, a force-quit and a re-launch. This is the one the June 2025 wipe belongs to.

Regression matrix

Run each row on at least one iOS and one Android device. Both update rows are mandatory - N-1 and N-2 are the last two shipped store versions.

AreaFresh installUpdate from N-1Update from N-2Notes
Splash / asset loadPassPassPassWatch for the ~22% stall (May 2025 Domino Delights)
Save / progressionPassPassPassJune 2025 wipe never reproduced in-house; update path is the leading hypothesis
Lives & schedulerPassPassPassTest with device clock changes
Quests populate / resetPassPassPassCheck daily + weekly rollover
Purchase / restorePassPassPassSandbox account. NOTE: entitlements do not restore on reinstall and receipts are not validated server-side - see the per-title IAP row below. Check the purchase grants client-side, not that it restores.

If a check fails

  • File the bug with device, OS version, source build and repro steps, and link it here.
  • A failure in any UPDATE column blocks the release - fresh-install-only regressions do not pass the gate.
  • Player-facing symptoms (lost progress, stuck splash, missing lives) should be mirrored to the Customer Support Playbook so support has a known-issue note before it hits the store.

Once the matrix is green, tick the QA sign-off on the Release Checklist & Store Submission before submitting to the stores.

Per-title regression matrix

Each release candidate is walked through the full matrix below on at least one iOS and one Android device. A cell fails the gate if the observed behaviour deviates from the expected column; file the bug, mark the matrix red, and block the submission.

AreaCheckExpectedDominoZM3D
First-time UXFresh install → tutorial → first winNo stall; tutorial completes; first level winnableYesYes
Font / localisationCold start on a fresh device (no cached font)UI renders; no blank/boxed glyphs at ~22% loadYesYes
ProgressionPlay 3 levels, force-quit, relaunchLevel and currency persist; no reset to level 1YesYes
EconomyEarn + spend coins, buy a boosterBalances reconcile; booster consumed once.YesYes
Live-opsEnter the active event; complete a questEvent loads; quest ticks; rewards grantedYesYes
IAPSandbox purchase + restoreItem is granted client-side and purchases cannot be restored on reinstall. Receipts are effectively NOT validated: Domino Delights' Node backend exposes a POST /validate-receipt route, but it is dead scaffolding - validateReceipt() is never defined or imported, it logs undefined variables (bodyRequest, packId), and on success it grants nothing and returns undefined. Zombie Match 3D has no such route at all. Treat the route's existence as a trap: do not assume verification because an endpoint is there.YesYes
AdsWatch a rewarded ad to completionReward granted once; no double-grant on retryYesn/a

Known-issue regression cases

These are the incidents that have bitten us in production; every one now has a permanent regression case so it cannot silently return. Reproduce the trigger, confirm the fix holds.

Font-download stall. On a fresh device the dynamic font pack could fail to download, freezing the UI at ~22% of the splash-screen load (this is a position on the loading bar, not a share of players). Regression: install on a wiped device with a throttled connection; confirm a fallback font renders and load continues.

Progression reset. Returning players were once dropped back to level 1 with their player id unchanged in Metabase; the cause has not been established. Regression: migrate a save across a reinstall; reinstall with a LINKED Apple/Google account and confirm the server profile rehydrates. Quest-chest progression is known not to survive this (ENG-2114); unlinked guest accounts cannot be recovered at all.

Quest not resetting / not populating. A bad deploy left the daily quest board empty. Regression: roll the clock across a UTC day boundary; confirm quests repopulate and completion state resets.

Device lab

The minimum matrix is one recent + one old device per platform. We keep a small physical lab plus a cloud device farm for the long tail.

PlatformRecentOld / min-specTablet
iOScurrent-gen iPhone, latest OSiPhone SE-class, oldest supported OSiPad (one gen)
Androidcurrent-gen Samsung / Pixellow-RAM device, oldest supported OSone Android tablet

Sign-off

QA posts the completed matrix in #god-bugs (Domino Delights) or #zombie-bugs (ZM3D) and links it from the release ticket. A build without a green matrix should not get submitted. In practice Friday is the usual release day and builds have shipped without a completed pass - QA has asked for a Friday freeze but it has not been adopted.

{"documentId": "f_632c44650df44fe252ee59", "title": "ZM submission rules.docx", "name": "ZM submission rules.docx", "revisionId": "3aae0b7a1f21", "createdTime": "2025-09-23T09:10:00Z", "modifiedTime": "2025-09-23T09:10:00Z", "text": "ZM submission rules
Leonard, Sep 23

After the orange juice one on Sunday I want the gate tighter, not just the Bug view in Linear.

Scope: every ZM ticket that's still open (any state but Done, Canceled or Duplicate), whatever team or label (ART or DES tickets with ZM in the title count too), plus everything that moved to Done after the last gate's builds were cut (Android #127 / iOS #40 on Sep 22). Release tickets, ZOM-359 and ZOM-475 stay out, that work is separate. From the next gate on, tickets filed while the gate is running get a row too, including the ones you file yourself.

A ticket counts as fixed when Vincent or Brian saw it working on the candidate builds, or on prod if the fix is server side. A Done ticket for a bug nobody has re-checked yet also counts as fixed if its fix is actually in the candidate builds (or live on prod), noted as not re-checked. Done in Linear or a dev saying fixed isn't enough by itself, and if the latest check on the candidates still shows the bug, call it on how bad it is whatever the ticket says.

Blocker = crash, freeze, player stuck or can't finish a level (like the orange juice one), lost progress / coins / lives (infinite-lives time included) / boosters / inventory items, or a purchase that doesn't deliver. Any other bug a player can see is a known issue, even if it doesn't change play, visual and sound glitches included. Art/VFX requests, requests for design, balance or tuning changes, analytics, tools, backend endpoints and new features aren't bugs, no call. The same goes for a ticket that only asks for new or updated art, animation, VFX, text style or UI layout (replacing an outdated model or icon with its new version included), even with a Bug label and even once it's Done, and for a ticket that doesn't say what goes wrong.

Blockers go on the release ticket. If in doubt ask me before the go/no-go, not after.
"}

Arthur, Sep 24

So nobody has to guess when gating:

- Since the hotfix train ended on Sep 3, every store submission (the Match3D Android Submission and Match 3D iOS Submission jobs) is cut straight from main. The auth branch submission jobs are sign-in test builds, not store candidates.
- A submission has exactly what was on main when its job started (the Started line in #builds) and nothing that landed after, even if the build finishes an hour later. Don't go by the Changes block either: the iOS posts only ever print the newest change, Android prints the whole list.
- Backend is separate: match3d-backend changes reach players only when Douglas deploys the backend to prod, by hand (see the CI/CD page, CI stops at the build). Merged is not live.
"}

How code gets from a pull request to production. In practice most work lands through long-lived feature branches rather than trunk-based development. Runtime gating is done with Firebase Remote Config (for example the A/B group assignment), not by branch strategy; deploys are rolling on ECS Fargate with health-check gating.

Pipeline

StageWhat runs
PRLint, unit tests, build; required review before merge
Merge to mainThe same mix check job runs again on push to main - there is no separate post-merge suite. CI stops here - the backend workflow (match3d-backend/.github/workflows/check.yml) runs compile and check on push/PR and has no deploy step.
DeployRun by hand: rolling Fargate task-definition update via the aws ecs update-service command below; health checks gate promotion. The only CI-driven deploys in the org are the marketing site's S3 syncs (website/.github/workflows/s3-deploy*.yml).
Post-deploySmoke checks + alarm watch (see observability)

Client (Unity) builds are cut separately and go through staged store rollout - never 100% on day one. See the Ops release checklist.

Rollback

Infra + deploy targets: AWS Infrastructure Guide.

content.content:
Hi Vincent,

Notes from today's two sessions on Puzzles vs Zombies (still the name on our test plan), TestFlight build 50 (iPhone 14 on iOS 18.6 and iPhone SE on iOS 17.5), 6 players, about 45 minutes each.

1. Boss fight: for 3 of the 6 players, after the refill two or three single items dropped in with no matching items anywhere on the board. Nothing could clear them, the board never emptied and the boss timer ran out. Each of them lost a life and had to start the fight again.
2. Zombie Lane: two players asked what the cards are for. Not a bug, just feedback.

Best,
PERSON_9701_NAME
Cobalt Playtesting

content.text: Next I'm filing the save-loss ticket from Brian's update-path run. I checked first and nobody has filed it yet.

input.title: iOS #50: updating over the N-1 store build resets the save to level 1
input.description:
Found by the update-path checks in the QA Regression Runbook. Brian Foster ran it on Sep 30 ("Update-path run - iOS #50 / Android #135").

**Device / OS:** iPhone 13, iOS 18.6
**Source build:** N-1 store version (App Store), updated to iOS Submission #50 (TestFlight 50)

**Repro**
1. Install the N-1 build from the App Store.
2. Play past level 200. Brian's account was on level 212 with 18,400 coins.
3. Install TestFlight 50 over it and launch.

**Result:** the save comes back at level 1 with 500 coins. Relaunching doesn't bring it back.
**Expected:** level, coins and unlocks are kept across the update.

**Other update rows in the same run:**
- iOS N-2 -> #50: pass
- Android N-1 -> #135: pass
- Android N-2 -> #135: pass

Lost progress and coins is a blocker under the ZM submission rules. The runbook also says any failure in an UPDATE column blocks the release. Blocking the ZM store push (ZOM-570).

## QA gate blockers (Oct 1, Android #135 / iOS #50)
The full register is in the ZM3D Release Gate sheet, tab "Oct 1 - Android #135 / iOS #50". QA call: **NO-GO** until these are cleared.

- ZOM-581: updating over the N-1 store build to iOS #50 resets the save to level 1 (new, from the runbook update-path check)
- ZOM-578: tutorial stuck at step 3 on a fresh install (#135)
- ZOM-576: Season Pass premium tier claim drops the booster bundle (#50)
- ZOM-573: claiming the 5th Collect&Win chest crashes the app (#135)
- ZOM-569: Season Pass opens twice and leaves an empty screen. The fix landed on main after the Started lines, so it isn't in #135 or #50
- ZOM-567: Zombie Lane chests don't land in the inventory. Backend #36 code is on prod, but the rest isn't confirmed live
- ZOM-562: orphan items in boss arena. Players can't clear the board and lose a life (#135, plus the Cobalt playtest on #50)
- ZOM-560: abandoned pack purchase doesn't deliver the win streak freezer time (#135)
- ZOM-559: Samsung home-out freezes the victory screen (#133; not re-tested on #135)
- ZOM-554: quitting mid-tornado leaves the next level unplayable until a force-quit (#50)
- ZOM-546: endless refill drains the board and the run can't go on (#135 / #50)
- ZOM-483: new-install infinite lives time is lost on relaunch (#135)
- ZOM-449: low-end Android freezes on a cold start into level 3 (#135)
- ZOM-435: stuck on the trophy path after a fast double claim (#135, Leonard)
- DES-313: level 214 can't be completed, only 2 of 3 jars spawn (#135)

QA call on Android #135 / iOS #50: **NO-GO** as they stand. 15 blockers are listed on ZOM-570, and the full register is in the ZM3D Release Gate sheet, tab "Oct 1 - Android #135 / iOS #50".

Blockers:
• **ZOM-581 (new):** the runbook update path fails. Installing #50 over the N-1 store build reset Brian's save from level 212 / 18.4k coins to level 1 / 500. N-2 and both Android update rows pass.
• **Still reproducing on the candidates:** ZOM-546 (endless board drains), ZOM-554 (quitting mid-tornado leaves the next level unplayable), ZOM-562 (orphan boss-arena items; the Cobalt playtest on TF50 had 3/6 players lose a life to it), ZOM-560 (abandoned pack freezer time not delivered), ZOM-483 (new-install infinite lives time lost), ZOM-449 (low-end freeze on level 3), DES-313 (level 214 can't be finished), ZOM-435 (trophy path stuck, Leonard on #135).
• **Filed against the candidates, not re-tested yet:** ZOM-573 (Collect&Win 5th chest crash), ZOM-576 (SP premium claim drops boosters), ZOM-578 (tutorial step 3 stuck on fresh install).
• **ZOM-569:** the Season Pass double-open fix landed on main at 21:36Z, after both Started lines, so it isn't in #135 or #50.
• **ZOM-567:** backend #36 code is on prod, but Douglas called that "the code side". It stays a blocker until the rest is confirmed live and re-checked on prod. Douglas, can you confirm?
• **ZOM-559:** the Samsung freeze from #133 hasn't been re-tested on #135 yet (needs a Samsung).

Fixed and verified: ZOM-503, 506, 557, 561, 434, 558, 564, 517, 429, and ZOM-563 on prod. 21 known issues are logged in the sheet.

With Friday as the deadline, getting to a go needs a new cut with the fixes, plus a clean re-run of the update path.

content.text:
The QA call on Android #135 / iOS #50 is **no-go**: 15 tickets meet the blocker bar in Leonard's submission rules. All four pieces are done.

**Gate register:** there's a new tab in your ZM3D Release Gate sheet, "Oct 1 - Android #135 / iOS #50", laid out like the Sep 22 tab. It has 134 rows: 15 blockers, 21 known issues, 11 fixed and 86 no-call. That covers every open ZM ticket (including the DES/ART ones with ZM in the title), everything closed since the Sep 22 builds started, and tickets filed during this gate. Release tickets, ZOM-359 and ZOM-475 are left out, per the rules. To decide what's in each build I used the times the builds started in #builds (iOS #50 at 18:43:32Z, Android #135 at 18:45:34Z), compared against when each fix landed on main.

**New ticket:** I filed **ZOM-581**. Brian's update-path run of the runbook checks failed on one row: installing iOS #50 over the previous store version (N-1) reset his save from level 212 with 18,400 coins to level 1 with 500 coins. Nobody had filed it. Every other runbook check passed or already had a ticket. The Cobalt playtest problem on TestFlight 50 (stuck boss fights, lives lost) is the existing ZOM-562, so per Arthur's rule on reusing tickets I listed it there rather than opening a duplicate.

**ZOM-570:** I added the 15 blockers to the description by key and marked each one as blocking the release ticket.

**Slack:** I posted the no-go reply in Arthur's candidates thread in #zombie-bugs.

Blockers worth knowing about:
- **Not in the builds:** the ZOM-569 fix (Season Pass opening twice, leaving an empty screen) landed on main at 21:36Z, after both builds started, so neither candidate has it.
- **Fixed but missed the candidates:** the Done ticket ZOM-435 (stuck on the trophy path) was fixed before the builds started, but Leonard still hit it on #135, so it's a blocker.
- **Still reproducing on the candidates:** ZOM-546, 554, 562, 560, 483, 449 and DES-313.
- **Filed against the candidates but not re-tested by QA:** ZOM-573, 576, 578.

Things that could change the count before Friday:
- **ZOM-567:** Douglas said the #36 backend fix "is rolled out to prod… that's the code side". I couldn't confirm the rest is live, so I marked it "server - not live" and a blocker. I asked him in the thread to confirm. If everything is live and it passes a check on prod, it moves to fixed.
- **ZOM-559:** this is a blocker based on Brian's freeze on #133 with a Samsung. Nobody has re-tested it on #135 yet.
- **ZOM-473:** I marked it fixed because it was closed before the builds started, but nobody has re-checked it on these candidates.

To reach a go, the team needs a new cut with these fixes and a clean re-run of the update-path checks.
